lines.text: Five merchant houses. One desert bazaar. And every merchant is an NFT that owns its own NEAR wallet.
Your house is a charter NFT on NEAR testnet. It holds its own vault of NEAR, its stock is on-chain tokens, and its card redraws itself as the business lives or dies.
Four rival houses think for themselves. They cry their wares, bring you deals of their own, race you for Palace orders, and remember who insulted them.
Haggle with any of them. Your browser signs your side of the deal, their wallet signs theirs, and one transaction settles both.
Then, on day six, a magnate arrives with deep pockets and no goodwill. He sells below cost until the bazaar breaks. <short pause> Then he owns it.
So fight back. Rally the rivals into a pact, buy off his carts, borrow from the Moneylenders' Guild, and keep your customers loyal.
Make it not worth his gold, and he leaves. Every deal, loan and takeover is a real transaction, and a charter's money goes wherever the NFT goes.
Seize three charters to become Sovereign, then keep your house: mint it to your own wallet. <short pause> Play free at bazaar dot reconscribe dot com.
